title: Trump says U.S. and Canada reached deal to delay 50% U.S. tariffs on Canadian imports
script: This is a short news brief with the key details. The main headline is this: Trump says U.S. and Canada reached deal to delay 50% U.S. tariffs on Canadian imports. In simple words, President Trump said he was delaying the 50% U.S. tariffs on Canadian imports after the two countries reached a last-minute deal less than two hours before the sanctions were to go into effect Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update.
